evidence.definitive_type_gate: fifteen actual kernel comparisons and seventeen explicit type proofs

findings.detail: The R parameter equality holds for n>=0 at true shifted regular points. The actual remainder and original-system transports retain n>=1, including the full DP+H polynomial equality. The n0 clipped-V difference counterexample is actually proved.
No division by Rold or nonzero-Rold hypothesis is present. The n2,t2 regular point has both actual R values zero and nonzero D; its cross-multiplied parameter equality is actually verified.

The independent project uses Lake default package-first search ordering. Actual findOLean selected all fourteen native modules from pi1/b. The exact path contains only pinned package caches, pi1/b and Lean4.33.1 runtime; no Root or author project cache is present. An initial Python final gate overstrictly demanded pi1/b be first; it is retained and excluded and replaced with the exact allowed-path-set plus actual object-resolution gate.

This closes true finite rational-function transports and the five unique actual polynomial systems. Formal F-coordinate transport, infinite-sum parameter transport, determinant formulas, arithmetic height/content and irrationality are outside this verdict.

Old dc6299 preparation and author first-source compile1 remain retained and excluded. Two independent pure Python reporting failures (initial schema KeyError and GBK glyph output) are retained and excluded. The first own boundary file inferred four literal-bound indices Rat; the second retry used invalid typed bounded-forall syntax; the third needed explicit rational 2+1=3 normalization for the last n2 specialization. All three complete failed runs are retained and excluded. The v4 file changes only those four quantifiers to explicit Nat forall/arrow syntax and adds that final numeral proof; all twenty-seven controls actually passed. The first kernel comparison script had one trailing unmatched parenthesis: its whole failed run is excluded, and the separately retained v2 succeeds after removing only that parenthesis. Existing source comments saying first compilation is pending are historical; actual current same-byte compile receipts govern the verdict.
